name: The Solar Guidance of Lionman
aspect: The founding legend of the Jharwa outliers
notes: The founding legend of the Jharwa outliers, detailing how the golden-maned solar guardian used his burning obsidian claws to clear brush and strike fire, protecting the regressed Vanara tribes from the horrors of the long shadow-cold. The establishment of fire-keeping shrines dedicated to the sun. The myth of the Solar Claw that carved the first safety circles in the tall savanna grass.
sources: Oral Histories of the Jharwa Outliers
